title: Skill-Adaptive Noise Scheduling for Diffusion Policies
abstract: arXiv:2611.30264v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in diffusion policies have demonstrated strong effectiveness when integrated into hierarchical skill-based learning frameworks, leveraging offline data to capture multimodal and temporally abstracted behaviors. However, prior approaches have rarely considered the diffusion process as a learnable component, adopting fixed noise schedules applied uniformly across skills, regardless of their distinct behavioral contexts. Such a design fundamentally limits the achievable performance, particularly for contact-rich and dexterous manipulation tasks where different skills exhibit distinct couplings between action dimensions. In this paper, we present a skill-adaptive noise diffusion framework (SaND) which introduces a learnable, skill-conditioned noise schedule that modulates the diffusion process per action dimension, adapting the noising dynamics to each skill. To prevent the learned noise schedule from collapsing into trivia

translated_title: 面向扩散策略的技能自适应噪声调度
translated_abstract: 扩散策略的最新进展表明，当其集成到分层的基于技能的学习框架中时表现出强大的有效性，能够利用离线数据捕捉多模态且时间上抽象化的行为。然而，先前的方法很少将扩散过程视为可学习的组件，而是采用在所有技能上统一应用的固定噪声调度，而不考虑各技能不同的行为情境。这种设计从根本上限制了所能达到的性能，尤其是在接触密集型和灵巧操作任务中，不同技能在动作维度之间呈现出不同的耦合关系。本文提出了一种技能自适应噪声扩散框架，引入了一种可学习的、以技能为条件的噪声调度，能够按动作维度调节扩散过程，使加噪动力学适应于每种技能。为防止学习到的噪声调度坍缩为平凡的……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出技能自适应噪声扩散框架SaND，通过可学习的技能条件化噪声调度按动作维度调节扩散过程，使加噪动力学适配各技能的特性，从而提升扩散策略在接触密集和灵巧操作任务上的表现。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SaND, a skill-adaptive noise diffusion framework that introduces a learnable, skill-conditioned noise schedule to modulate the diffusion process per action dimension, adapting noising dynamics to each skill for improved contact-rich and dexterous manipulation performance.
